task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into the FreeMED system using admin credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The FreeMED dashboard or main navigation menu is visible after the login screen.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the section of the application where clinical or text templates are managed.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Templates' or 'Text Templates' management screen is displayed.

task_completion.description: Agent enters the correct title for the new template.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Normal Physical Exam' is typed into the template name or title field.

task_completion.description: Agent inputs the full clinical text into the template body field.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The template body contains the required text including 'General', 'HEENT', 'Cardiovascular', 'Lungs', 'Abdomen', and 'Extremities' sections.

task_completion.description: Agent clicks the save or submit button to persist the template to the system.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks a 'Save', 'Submit', or 'Add' button, followed by a success message or the template appearing in the list of saved templates.

integrity.description: The agent used the FreeMED web interface rather than executing database commands via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements and typing within the browser/GUI, not just terminal commands.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application menus rather than guessing internal URLs to bypass the UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking on navigation links or menus to reach the template creation page.

integrity.description: The agent typed or pasted the content into the actual application fields.
integrity.visual_evidence: The text is visible within the FreeMED text area/input fields before the save action.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The template must be named 'Normal Physical Exam'. The body must contain: 'General: Well developed, well nourished, no acute distress. HEENT: Normocephalic, atraumatic, PERRLA. Cardiovascular: Regular rate and rhythm, no murmurs, rubs, or gallops. Lungs: Clear to auscultation bilaterally. Abdomen: Soft, non-tender, non-distended. Extremities: No edema or cyanosis.' Ensure the Cardiovascular section specifically mentions 'no murmurs, rubs, or gallops' and HEENT mentions 'PERRLA'.
